binding: Stories 6.2 (REL-3 formal soak) and 6.1 (REL-1 physical two-machine demonstration) pin THIS candidate. Any change to server/ or the packaging inputs voids the candidate: cut a new one (re-materialize), rerun the Story 6.3 gates, and restart the soak (docs/implementation/reviews/epic-6-execution-agy.md, 'The Candidate Immutability Law').

source.working_tree_note: This candidate was re-cut AGAIN on 2026-10-21 after Story 6.4 changed the packaged runtime inputs: the reconnect-recovery repair (the explicit same-Actor session takeover with an atomic transfer and a fence) touched server/api/session.mjs, server/api/server.mjs, server/api/pipeline.mjs, server/api/routes.mjs, server/core/session-registry.mjs, server/client/api-client.mjs, server/mcp-stdio.mjs, server/cli/* and server/constants.mjs. The repair was required: the physical two-machine demonstration found that a client whose process was killed left its Chat ID reserved by a dead session's lease, and the ordinary re-bind was refused with chat_id_taken - FR-12 continuity, inside v0.2.0's scope per the advisor review (docs/implementation/reviews/epic-6-lease-astra.md). The previous candidate 89c8477 and the soak attempts pinned to it remain in git history as that artifact's record; they do not qualify this one.

artifacts.digest_algorithm: SHA-256 folded over every regular file in package-relative path-sorted order: for each file, update with hex(sha256(relative_path)) + '\n' + hex(sha256(file_bytes)) + '\n'; the final hex digest is the tree digest (tests/release-smoke.test.mjs, treeDigest). No metadata (mtimes, modes, inodes) enters the digest.

sm_c1_remeasurement.verification_note: three five-install runs of the final gate: fifteen fresh installs, zero failures, every run inside the rule. The first (raw mean 0.761 s) was measured while this workstation was under load from the cross-machine demonstration; the second (0.551 s) after that work was torn down; the third (0.460 s) is this re-cut's frozen run, measured on the quiet machine before the REL-1 round. All three are recorded; the third is frozen.
sm_c1_remeasurement.rule_reading: the ladder delta is exactly the two Chat ID choices (v0.1's room_create/room_join collapse into the two room_direct_open calls); the ladder with those rows priced out is 0.265 s mean - below v0.1's 0.352 s anchor. 0 failures. No regression beyond the choice.
sm_c1_remeasurement.noise_bounds: declared in tests/release-smoke.test.mjs: adjusted-mean gate at 3x the anchor, raw-mean gate at 5x, both absorbing in-suite parallel-load noise (raw means reach ~1.26 s when the full suite runs concurrently); the recorded numbers above are the quiet-machine human-verdict comparison
